items.exampleEn: There is a flower shop near my home.
The shoes are on sale today.
I go shopping with my sister on Sunday.
items.exampleZh: 我星期天和姊姊去逛街。

items.exampleEn: Can I pay with a credit card?
items.exampleZh: 我可以用信用卡付款嗎？

items.audioEn: This dress is too expensive. Let's go to a different shop.
items.audioZh: 這件洋裝太貴了，我們去別家店吧。
items.questionZh: 為什麼他們要去別家店？

items.sentenceEn: I love shopping on the weekend.
Can I use my credit card here?
items.sentenceZh: 我可以在這裡用信用卡嗎？

items.stemEn: Everything in this store is on ____ today.
I don't have any money with me, but I have a ____.
items.stemZh: 我身上沒帶錢，但我有信用卡。

items.passageEn: Tina loves shopping. Today there is a big sale at her favorite shop. A coat is usually 200 dollars, but today it is only 100 dollars. Tina is not rich, but she buys the coat with her credit card. She is very happy.
items.passageZh: Tina 很愛購物。今天她最喜歡的那家店有大特價。一件大衣平常是 200 美元，但今天只要 100 美元。Tina 不是有錢人，但她用信用卡買下了那件大衣。她非常開心。

rubricZh: 「太貴」例如 too expensive；寫 costs too much 也正確
外套可用 jacket 或 coat

items.promptZh: 今天下午我們去購物吧。
rubricZh: 「去購物」用 go shopping（不寫成 go to shopping）
「今天下午」可寫，例如 this afternoon 等
